author: PantherClaw
description: A detection rule raised a HIGH or CRITICAL alert. How the alert knows what it says is in unmapped.pantherclaw_uncertainty: read it before you act.
false_positives: A detection rule tuned too widely for this organization.
name: PantherClaw high or critical alert
query: class_uid: 2004 and activity_id: 1 and severity_id: (4 or 5) and not metadata.labels: "test"

author: PantherClaw
description: An incident was opened or reopened.
false_positives: An incident a person opened to test a procedure.
name: PantherClaw incident opened
query: class_uid: 2005 and activity_id: 1 and not metadata.labels: "test"

author: PantherClaw
description: PantherClaw denied an action or could not authorize it. One denial is the product working; a run of them from one agent is worth a look.
false_positives: A new agent working out what its grant covers.
name: PantherClaw denied an agent action
query: class_uid: 6003 and metadata.event_code: "receipt.decision" and status_id: 2 and not metadata.labels: "test"

author: PantherClaw
description: A coverage record for an agent or connection was invalidated, so what used to be enforced may no longer be.
false_positives: A planned change to a gateway or connection.
name: PantherClaw enforcement coverage invalidated

author: PantherClaw
description: A containment control was applied, a run was terminated or a credential was revoked.
name: PantherClaw containment action
query: metadata.event_code: ("audit.response.contain" or "audit.response.run_terminated" or "audit.response.credential_revoked") and not metadata.labels: "test"

author: PantherClaw
description: A person engaged the organization's kill switch.
name: PantherClaw kill switch engaged

author: PantherClaw
description: A SIEM export destination was created, activated, paused, disabled or had its secret rotated. A paused export is a blind spot in this very SIEM.
name: PantherClaw SIEM export changed

author: PantherClaw
description: PantherClaw found an agent nobody has enrolled.
false_positives: A team trying out a new tool.
name: PantherClaw discovered an unclaimed agent
